claims.claim_text: On the older units, don't trust the green link status after an SFP change: sometimes the interface comes up but forwarding doesn't recover. Usually the SFP is fine, so don't swap it again; check whether traffic counters increase, and if they stay at zero with the interface UP, disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again. Don't reboot the whole unit unless that fails.
claims.symptom: after SFP replacement link is up and alarms cleared but traffic does not come back (counters stay at zero)
